claims.claim: Q2 2026 reported sales were $25.3 billion.
Q2 2026 reported sales grew 6.6%.
Q2 2026 reported (GAAP) diluted EPS was $2.27.
Q2 2026 adjusted EPS (non-GAAP) was $2.90.
Q2 2026 adjusted net earnings (non-GAAP) were $7,081 million.
Innovative Medicine Q2 2026 reported sales were $16,384 million.
Innovative Medicine Q2 2026 reported sales grew 7.8%.
Innovative Medicine worldwide operational sales grew 6.8% in Q2 2026.
Innovative Medicine growth was driven by DARZALEX, CARVYKTI, TECVAYLI and RYBREVANT/LAZCLUZE in Oncology, and TREMFYA and Other Immunology in Immunology.
Innovative Medicine growth was partially offset by STELARA (an approximate 760 basis points impact) and REMICADE in Immunology, and IMBRUVICA and ZYTIGA in Oncology.
MedTech Q2 2026 reported sales were $8,926 million.
MedTech Q2 2026 reported sales grew 4.5%.
MedTech worldwide operational sales grew 3.6% in Q2 2026.
MedTech growth was driven by wound closure and biosurgery products in Surgery, electrophysiology products and Shockwave in Cardiovascular, contact lenses in Vision, and trauma in Orthopaedics.
The company increased 2026 guidance for estimated reported sales to a midpoint of $101.1 billion, representing 7.3% growth at the midpoint.
The company increased 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to a midpoint of $11.68, or 8.2% at the midpoint.
The company increased 2026 adjusted operational EPS guidance to a midpoint of $11.58, or 7.3% at the midpoint.
Q2 2026 free cash flow was approximately $8,700 million.
claims.note: The release's ~$8,700 million free cash flow is second-quarter YTD 2026 (and estimated as of July 15, 2026), not the quarter alone; the release gives no standalone Q2 free cash flow figure.

claims.claim: Divestitures negatively impacted Innovative Medicine worldwide operational sales growth by 10 basis points in Q2 2026.
The company stated it is unable to predict with reasonable certainty the ultimate outcome of legal proceedings and unusual gains and losses.
Translational currency contributed 1.0% to worldwide sales growth in Q2 2026.
